dct_title_s: South America, Colombia--north coast, Puerto Colombia to Santa Marta (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the Defense Mapping Agency Hydrographic/Topographic Center. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. "From various sources to 1992." "Copyright restrictions of the country of origin continue to exist." "Soundings in meters." Includes source diagram. Map no.24491.
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
